title: Single-verb help prints per-flag descriptions; read-once rule in docs
action: Per CONTEXT.md D1-D3: (a) in verbs/help.rs render_help_text, when exactly ONE entry is rendered (single-verb help), replace the compact 'flags:' line with a detail block: a 'flags:' header line, then one indented line per flag — '--name' plus '*' when required, the type abbreviation in parens, an em-dash, then the flag's registry parameters.properties description (fall back to the compact form for a flag with no description). Multi-entry renders keep the existing compact flags_line. The json flag stays omitted (existing filter + header note). Extend help.rs unit tests in the existing style: single-entry render shows a described flag's line with its description and required star; multi-entry render still uses the compact line. (b) in hooks/session_preamble/budget.rs:160 extend the Command-surface sentence with the read-once rule: before the FIRST use of a verb in a session, read bee <verb> --help — never guess flags; one read per verb, never re-read. Adjust any preamble snapshot/budget test that pins the old sentence. (c) in AGENTS.md, extend the existing 'Spend full text on bee <command> --help' sentence with the same read-once rule, one sentence, matching prose style. No new dump-all surface (D3).
